intro.h2: A new look for the kitchen you already have
paragraphs: Nu-Look Kitchens specializes in cabinet refacing in Dubuque: new doors and finished surfaces on your existing cabinet boxes, so the kitchen looks new without tearing everything out. Customers who want a full change can get new cabinets and countertops too.

Rik and Toni had their cabinets refaced in a 60-year-old home and wrote that it makes their kitchen look brand new. Another family says Kent sat down with them and went over everything in detail, then stayed responsive whenever they had a question. Their installer, Dan, put in new cabinets in less than two days, covered everything up while he worked and cleaned up after himself.

items.name: Cabinet refacing
items.blurb: Refacing keeps your cabinet layout and boxes and gives them a new face. Rik and Toni's 60-year-old kitchen got refaced cabinets, which they paired with new countertops, a sink, a mosaic backsplash and a new floor for what they call a gourmet kitchen.

image.alt: Refaced oak kitchen cabinets with white countertops, glass mosaic backsplash and double stainless sink in a 60-year-old home

items.name: New kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: When you want new cabinets, Nu-Look supplies and installs them. Customers describe the cabinets as excellent quality and very reasonably priced, and one family had their new cabinets installed in less than two days, with everything covered and cleaned up afterwards.

image.alt: Cream raised-panel kitchen cabinets with a tall pantry, brushed nickel pulls and crown moulding

items.name: Countertops
items.blurb: New countertops finish a refaced or new-cabinet kitchen. Nu-Look's photos show white granite with grey and black veining on a work run and island, and light countertops wrapping a U-shaped oak kitchen around a double sink. Ask Kent which materials suit your cabinets.

image.alt: U-shaped kitchen with refaced oak cabinets, light countertops and a double sink under the window

about.text: Nu-Look Kitchens is a Dubuque kitchen remodeler focused on cabinet refacing, new cabinets and countertops. Kent is the person customers sit down with to plan the work, and he answers Google reviews himself, thanking families by name. Reviewers also name the installers: Dan, who put in one family's cabinets in less than two days, and Al, whom another customer recommends after a job with some challenging issues. The Google profile holds 71 photos, from refaced oak kitchens in older homes to cream raised-panel kitchens with granite islands.

service_area.h2: Cabinet refacing in Dubuque and the surrounding area
service_area.text: Nu-Look Kitchens is listed in Dubuque, Iowa, and does its refacing, cabinet and countertop work right in your home. Kent sits down with you to plan the project, then the installers take care of the work from there. If you live in or around Dubuque and want to know whether your home is in range, call (563) 582-4680 or email refacing@yousq.net.

items.a: Refacing gives your existing cabinets a new face, with new doors and finished surfaces, while the cabinet boxes and layout stay where they are. Rik and Toni had it done in a 60-year-old home and said it makes their kitchen look brand new. They paired it with new countertops, a sink, a backsplash and a floor.

items.q: Can I get new cabinets instead?
items.a: Yes. Nu-Look also installs new kitchen cabinets. One family had new cabinets installed in less than two days and described them as excellent quality and very reasonably priced. Kent can go over both options with you so you can compare what suits your kitchen and budget.

Yes. Countertops come up in reviews, and Nu-Look's photos show white granite on a work run and island, and light countertops wrapping a U-shaped kitchen around a double sink. Ask Kent which countertop materials suit your refaced or new cabinets.

It depends on the size of the kitchen and the work involved. Quick installs come up again and again in reviews, and one family's new cabinets were installed in less than two days. Older homes can bring surprises, and customers say the installers resolve those problems well.

Call (563) 582-4680 or email refacing@yousq.net. Kent will set up a time to sit down with you and go over everything in detail, from refacing versus new cabinets to countertops and price. Customers say he is very responsive to questions along the way.
